    A Skill Most Professionals Use Every Day—But Few Actually Develop You might be great at your job. You might have years of experience. You might even have excellent technical skills. But can you explain your ideas clearly in writing? Think about how much of our work happens through: Emails Messages Reports Presentations Proposals Workplace communication A good idea can easily get ignored when it’s poorly communicated. That’s why clear writing is a career skill—not just a language skill. Strong professional writers know how to: 🔹 Get to the point They don't make people read five paragraphs to understand one simple message. 🔹 Explain complex ideas simply Being able to make something understandable is a valuable skill. 🔹 Write for the reader They think about what the other person needs to know—not just what they want to say. 🔹 Structure information properly Clear headings, short paragraphs, and logical flow make communication easier. 🔹 Choose the right tone The way you write to a client, manager, colleague, or recruiter shouldn't always be the same. 💡 Here's the interesting part: You don't need to be a professional writer to become a better professional communicator. Start with one simple habit: 👉 Before sending anything, ask yourself: “If I received this message, would I understand it immediately?” That small question can improve your emails, reports, applications, and workplace communication. Because sometimes, the person with the best idea isn't the one who gets noticed. It's the person who can explain that idea clearly. 💬 Which professional communication skill do you think people underestimate the most? Writing, speaking, listening, or presentation? canonical.text: | Career Opportunity  Position: Leadership Development Facilitator Position Title: Leadership Development Facilitator Project Name: Collective Impact on Future of Work in Bangladesh Project Number of Position: 02 Location: Gazipur Hub Office  Duration: Duration of the contract will be up to August 31, 2027.     	 		 			| I.            Job Summary:    |   			| Who are we? As a global leader, CARE is shaping the future of the humanitarian and development sector. Each year, we deliver support and services to millions of people in over a hundred countries. We do this by focusing on our mission and living the values that drive our organization. A career at CARE is an opportunity to be part of a movement that brings communities together to solve complex problems and foster lasting change throughout the world. We seek individuals who are passionate about humanitarian and development work, collaborate well with others, embrace learning and innovation, and deliver results.   What it’s like to work at CARE? CARE is a mission-driven international humanitarian aid and development organization that offers an opportunity to work with people across the world. Not a day will go by that you won’t learn something profound, meet an expert, or write a sentence that can change a life. We are committed to an environment where everyone can succeed.   Scope of Work: Project Background: Oporajita: Collective Impact for Just Transition for Women in the RMG Ecosystem builds on the achievements of its previous phase, completed in May 2026. The current phase focuses on strengthening and sustaining Women Cafés in Jamirdia and Gauripur (Bhaluka, Mymensingh), Savar (Dhaka), and Kashimpur (Gazipur).The project aims to establish self-sustaining, women-led Women Cafés as financially viable business and support hubs, providing women garment workers and former workers with opportunities for entrepreneurship, market linkages, peer learning, psychosocial well-being, leadership development, and community engagement.   The Leadership Development Facilitator will be based at the Women Café at the Union level /ward level and will play a key role in strengthening women’s leadership, collective action, self-initiative, and entrepreneurship for a self-sustaining Women Café under the Oporajita project, funded by the H&M Foundation and COS. The project aims to establish self-sustaining, women-led Women Cafés as financially viable business and support hubs that strengthen women’s economic empowerment, agency, and resilience through entrepreneurship, market linkages, peer learning, and community support. The facilitator will work closely with the Psychosocial Counsellor and Market Development Facilitator to strengthen the capacity of women to manage the café, promote harmony and collaboration among women-led enterprises, and encourage collective efforts toward long-term sustainability. The position will support women to build leadership, communication, decision-making, teamwork, conflict management, and business management skills, enabling them to take greater ownership of the Women Café and related enterprises. The facilitator will also play a key community-level role, fostering linkages, participation, collective initiatives, and community engagement to create an enabling environment for women’s enterprises to grow and become self-sustaining. |     	 		 			| II. Responsibilities and Tasks:    | % of Time |   			| Responsibility # 1: Women Café Management, Community Engagement and Local-Level Coordination | 40% |   			|  				Coordinate the day-to-day operation and management of the Women Café at Union level, ensuring a safe, inclusive and women-led space. Mobilise women workers, farmers, entrepreneurs, youth and community members, including women outside formal employment, to engage with the Women Café. Coordinate with the Café Management Committee for planning, implementation and effective functioning of the café. Organize and facilitate meetings, workshops, consultations and networking events at the community level. Establish and maintain coordination with Union Parishad, local government, social service providers, community leaders, women’s groups, private-sector actors and other stakeholders. Facilitate linkages between women and relevant government, social, financial, health, skills and other local services. Promote collective ownership, harmony, mutual support and shared responsibility among women and women-led enterprises. Strengthen the Women Café as a community-level platform for women’s leadership, enterprise development, networking and access to services. |   |   			| Responsibility # 2: Capacity Building and Mentoring of Women Café Management Committee | 40% |   			|  				Strengthen the capacity, leadership, communication and ownership of the Women Café Management Committee for effective and sustainable café management. Establish transparent, accountable and participatory governance, financial management and decision-making systems. Build capacity on leadership, teamwork, conflict management, financial literacy, café management and basic business skills. Strengthen Savings Associations/Groups, including transparent savings management, record keeping and effective utilisation of women’s savings. Provide regular mentoring, coaching and follow-up support to the Café Management Committee, savings groups and women entrepreneurs. Support the development of business, sustainability and collective entrepreneurship initiatives to generate income and reduce dependency on project support. Facilitate peer learning, experience sharing and collective problem-solving among women. |   |   			| Responsibility # 3: Reporting and Local Representation | 10% |   			|  				Maintain proper documentation of activities, referrals, participation and follow-up. Prepare regular progress, activity, success-story and learning reports and support KPI reporting. Support the MEAL/M&E team in monitoring, data collection, verification, assessments and learning activities. Serve as the CARE focal point at the local level, representing CARE in relevant government, community and stakeholder meetings. Coordinate with the Market Development Facilitator and Psychosocial Counsellor to ensure women receive timely and integrated support based on their needs. Prepare monthly work plan |   |   			| Responsibility # 4: Other Activities | 5% |   			|  				Participate in meetings, workshop, training and activities in community level as assigned. Perform any other duties as and when required. |   |   			| General Responsibilities on Safety and Security, and Safeguarding of children and vulnerable adults | 5% |   			| As part of this role, the job holder must adhere to and support CARE Bangladesh’s Safety and Security policy and systems as part of their day-to-day duties and comply with safety & security protocols and directives, including reporting. Staff must maintain situational and self–awareness and be aware of the safety – security-related consequences of their actions upon themselves, their team, and the organization.   CARE is committed to preventing any type of unwanted behavior at work including sexual harassment, exploitation and abuse, lack of integrity, and financial misconduct, and expects staff to promote the welfare of children, young people, and adults always.  CARE expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment through our Code of Conduct.  We place a high priority on ensuring that only those who share and demonstrate this commitment are recruited to work with us.   All CARE staff must uphold ethical standards, following codes of conduct to prevent abuse, including sexual harassment, exploitation, and neglect. Regular monitoring ensures accountability to uphold these principles and support our mission of social justice and poverty alleviation. |     	 		 			| III. Reporting to:    |   			| Manager |     	 		 			| IV.         Working Conditions:   |   			| Based at Gazipur Hub Office |     	 		 			|  				Qualification: |   			|  				Bachelar degree in Social Sciences, Development Studies, Gender Studies, Sociology, Social Work, Business Administration, or a related field. Minimum 2-3 years of relevant professional experience in community development, women’s empowerment, leadership development, enterprise development, or similar programmes. Good working knowledge of English. Proven experience in facilitation, mentoring, community mobilization, stakeholder coordination, and organizing meetings/workshops. Experience in community engagement and building effective relationships with local government, service providers and other stakeholders. Strong communication, interpersonal, coordination and networking skills, with the ability to work effectively with diverse groups. Ability to mobilize women and communities, facilitate collective action, and support women-led initiatives. Experience working with Women’s Groups or community-based enterprises. Experience coordinating with local government, Union Parishad and local service providers. Strong skills in leadership coaching, mentoring, conflict management, collective action Ability to work independently at community/Union level and coordinate effectively with different technical teams. |    Candidates need to be highly motivated and committed to CARE Bangladesh’s vision, mission, and long-term development work to significantly improve the lives of the most vulnerable and marginalized people. Candidates must be capable of displaying great learning agility, support and encourage knowledge sharing across projects, for the ultimate benefit of all of CARE’s mission wide initiatives.     Compensation    Monthly Consolidated salary will be BDT. 25,000.00.    Interested candidates meeting the above requirements should apply through https://bdjobs.com/  on or before September 15, 2026.      Note:  	CARE is an Equal Opportunity employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, sex, religion, ancestry, national origin, age, disability, marital status, or veteran status, or any other characteristics protected under applicable law.  Any personal persuasion/phone-call will result in disqualification of candidature. We guarantee an interview to disabled candidates who meet the essential criteria. CARE Bangladesh has a non-negotiable policy of ZERO TOLERANCE towards discrimination, harassment and abuse. All employees are expected to abide by the CARE International Safeguarding Policy. Internal and external applicants shall be treated equally in the entire selection process. To ensure transparent processes during recruitment, internal candidates should discuss potential applications with their Line Managers to ensure endorsement of their applications by respective Line Managers. CARE Bangladesh participates in the Inter-Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme. In line with this Scheme, we hereby request information from candidate’s previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse and/or sexual harassment during employment, or incidents under investigation when the candidate left employment. All offers of employment are subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms their understanding of these recruitment procedures. THERE IS NO COST INVOLVED WITH APPLYING FOR POSITIONS WITH CARE BANGLADESH. ANY SOLICITATION OF JOB APPLICATION COSTS SHOULD BE REGARDED AS FRAUDULENT. |
